capabilities: Export selected expense sections to Excel
Group expenses by card and payment source
extras: Processes notes locally and does not transmit note contents; saves a date-stamped .xlsx in the Exports folder and adds a number if the filename exists.
problem: Obsidian notes can hold expense lists, but turning a selected budget section into a structured Excel summary requires manual copying and subtotaling.

relations.evidence: turns a selected expense section in an Obsidian note into a formatted Excel summary.

summary: Expense-section exporter that turns selected Markdown budget entries into a grouped Excel workbook by card and payment source.
